/.title: Utopia ESSEC | AI Conferences, Hackathons & Consulting
/.description: Explore Utopia, ESSEC Business School’s AI association: conferences, hackathons, hands-on learning, consulting, and partnerships with the AI ecosystem.

/conferences.title: AI Conferences & Industry Talks | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences.description: Discover Utopia’s AI conferences and roundtables with founders, researchers, and industry leaders. Browse event dates, posters, and available event links.

/contact.title: Contact Utopia | ESSEC AI Association
/contact.description: Contact Utopia at utopia.essec@gmail.com about AI conferences, hackathons, consulting, partnerships, or joining ESSEC’s AI community.

/hackathons/secure-horizons.title: Secure Horizons — AI & Cybersecurity Hackathon | Utopia ESSEC
/hackathons/secure-horizons.description: A 36-hour AI and cybersecurity hackathon at ESSEC Cergy on 10–11 October 2026, organized by Utopia, Kryptosphère, and ESSEC Metalab.

/hackathons/paris-builds.title: Paris Builds — 36-Hour Hackathon | Utopia ESSEC
/hackathons/paris-builds.description: A 36-hour hackathon in Paris on 27–28 June 2026, organized by Unaite with Y Combinator, with tracks in agents, robotics, and startup building.

/hackathons/ai-venture-sprint.title: AI Venture Sprint — No-Code Hackathon | Utopia ESSEC
/hackathons/ai-venture-sprint.description: A six-hour no-code hackathon at ESSEC where teams built and pitched AI prototypes with Lovable for a €500 prize pool.

/hackathons/from-llm-to-agentic-ai.title: From LLM to Agentic AI — Hackathon | Utopia ESSEC
/hackathons/from-llm-to-agentic-ai.description: An agentic AI hackathon at ESSEC Cergy on 4–6 April 2025, organized by Utopia and Kryptosphère, with tracks in finance and cybersecurity and €4,050 in cash prizes.

/hackathons/consumer-edge-hack.title: Spotlight: Consumer Edge Hack — On-Device AI | Utopia ESSEC
/hackathons/consumer-edge-hack.description: An on-device AI hackathon in Paris on 22–23 November 2024, hosted by Entrepreneur First with Ekimetrics and Unaite, with judges from Kyutai, Photoroom, and Datakalab.

/hackathons.title: AI Hackathons & Builder Events | Utopia ESSEC
/hackathons.description: Explore AI hackathons from Utopia and its network, including Secure Horizons, Paris Builds, and AI Venture Sprint. Find event dates, posters, and details.

/conferences/future-of-ai.title: Future of AI — Roundtable | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/future-of-ai.description: A roundtable on the future of AI in France at Albert School, Paris, on 27 September 2024, with speakers from Mistral AI, Mirakl, Snowflake, and Kima Ventures.

/conferences/ia-a-tout-prix.title: IA à tout prix ? — Roundtable | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/ia-a-tout-prix.description: A roundtable on the major questions raised by AI at ESSEC Cergy on 15 October 2024, with Paul Midy, Isabelle Ryl (PRAIRIE), Victoire Mine (Meta), and Vincent Luciani (Artefact).

/conferences/ia-en-entreprise.title: L'IA en entreprise — Conference | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/ia-en-entreprise.description: A conference at Albert School, Paris, on 31 October 2024 about what AI really changes inside companies, with AI Sisters and AI Builders.

/conferences/arc-prize.title: ARC Prize University Tour — Paris | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/arc-prize.description: The Paris stop of the ARC Prize 2024 University Tour on 26 November 2024, hosted by Unaite, with François Chollet on ARC-AGI and the path to general intelligence.

/conferences/unaite-inaugural-conference.title: Unaite Inaugural Conference | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/unaite-inaugural-conference.description: The inaugural conference of Unaite at Université PSL on 2 December 2024, with roundtables on AI research and business featuring PRAIRIE, Kyutai, Inria, Meta, and more.

/conferences/meetup-alan.title: Meetup Alan | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/meetup-alan.description: A meetup at Alan’s Paris offices on 11 December 2024 for Unaite’s student AI associations, with Alan co-founder and CTO Charles Gorintin.

/conferences/start-from-scratch.title: Start From Scratch — Roundtable | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/start-from-scratch.description: A roundtable on building in AI at Albert School, Paris, on 22 January 2025, with Kima Ventures, Argil (YC S24), OpenAI, and a top GPT Store creator.

/conferences/droit-et-ia.title: Droit et IA — Roundtable | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/droit-et-ia.description: A roundtable on law and AI at August Debouzy, Paris, on 27 January 2025, with Lex ESSEC and speakers from Mistral AI, August Debouzy, and EDHEC.

/conferences/unaite-perplexity.title: Unaite x Perplexity — Fireside Chat | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/unaite-perplexity.description: A fireside chat with Perplexity co-founder and CEO Aravind Srinivas at Université PSL on 11 February 2025, during the AI Action Summit week in Paris.

/conferences/women-in-ai.title: Women in AI — Roundtable | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/women-in-ai.description: A roundtable on the role of women in AI and gender diversity at Université Paris Dauphine-PSL on 20 February 2025.

/conferences/building-outliers.title: Building Outliers — French Founders | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/building-outliers.description: An evening with the co-founders of Defacto, Fleet, and Luko at the HEC Paris Alumni House on 26 February 2025.

/conferences/healthcare-ai.title: HealthCare x AI — Panel | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/healthcare-ai.description: A panel on AI in healthcare at Albert School, Paris, on 12 March 2025, with Galion.exe, Theremia, and Sanofi.

/conferences/kpmg-ai-in-action.title: AI in Action — KPMG | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/kpmg-ai-in-action.description: A conference at KPMG La Défense on 25 March 2026 with the ESCP AI Society on how KPMG uses AI in audit, advisory, and cybersecurity.

/conferences/ai-investment-banking.title: AI × Investment Banking — Roundtable | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/ai-investment-banking.description: A roundtable with DAU’IA on 2 April 2026 with speakers from BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Goldman Sachs, and Blackroom.

/conferences/echos-of-2050.title: Echos of 2050 — Conference | Utopia ESSEC
/conferences/echos-of-2050.description: A conference at the Maison des ESSEC, Paris, on 16 June 2026 on AI, digital sovereignty, and the changes ahead, with the ESSEC Alumni Club Digital & Technology and VivaTech.
